description: Machine-readable canonical toolchain registry. Every session must DISCOVER -> RESOLVE -> INVOKE before implementing. Repaired 2026-07-20: Added Submit-RCDTicket.ps1 as first governed intake, corrected CDP bridge path from project archive to OPS canonical.

rule_text.headline: DISCOVER -> RESOLVE -> INVOKE
rule_text.prohibition: Do not rediscover, copy, wrap, fork, or reimplement an existing canonical tool before invoking it.
rule_text.gap_behavior: If the canonical entry point cannot satisfy the ticket, stop and emit CANONICAL_TOOL_CONTRACT_GAP with evidence. Do not create a parallel implementation.

tools.purpose: First governed ticket intake -- accept RCD/CDP envelopes and hand off to Conductor
tools.contract_gap_behavior: HALT: TICKET_INTAKE_CONTRACT_GAP -- cannot hand off governed envelope to Conductor

tools.purpose: Verify RGA authority artifacts and initialize daily truth anchors
tools.contract_gap_behavior: HALT: BOOTLOADER_CONTRACT_GAP — report missing or failing authority files

tools.purpose: Admit, preview, or roll back RGA authority artifacts
tools.contract_gap_behavior: HALT: ADMISSION_CONTRACT_GAP — report file that cannot be admitted through the canonical workflow

tools.purpose: Cross-lane CDP orchestration — pre-flight, guard, ExchangeRound dispatch, receipt correlation
tools.contract_gap_behavior: HALT: CONDUCTOR_CONTRACT_GAP — evidence that the Conductor cannot dispatch to the required target

tools.purpose: One CDP exchange round — inject, observe, classify, write receipt
prohibited_reimplementations: direct inject_and_observe calls from external scripts
tools.contract_gap_behavior: Report target-specific bridge limitations (e.g., stabilization interval)

tools.purpose: Python CDP WebSocket transport — last-mile delivery to provider pages
prohibited_reimplementations: direct import from non-RCD Tools tree
tools.contract_gap_behavior: Report bridge import or delivery failure

tools.purpose: Validate RGA authority, Daily Bundle, and Cold Lane before building context cache
tools.contract_gap_behavior: Report admission, verification, or publication failure

tools.purpose: Orchestrate RGA boot, cache build, page discovery, and Conductor invocation for DeepSeek hydration
tools.contract_gap_behavior: Report which step (boot, build, discovery, Conductor) failed

tools.purpose: Governed CLI wrapper for Copilot lane with CacheStartup integration
prohibited_reimplementations: manual gh copilot invocation outside wrapper
tools.contract_gap_behavior: Report wrapper guard or flag error

tools.purpose: Operator WPF GUI for CDP handoff and browser management
prohibited_reimplementations: custom WPF or CDP handoff UI outside canonical tool
tools.contract_gap_behavior: Report GUI launch or CDP probe failure
